title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Inspecting pages (Page inspection)
summary: This post is an index of the author's blog series on page inspection in Business Central. It links to articles on analyzing performance with the page inspector, telling standard pages or reports from customized ones, controlling or hiding inspection details, and checking page filters. It also links to version-specific tips: the collapsible pane (BC18), text and code field sizes (BC21), and field highlighting and opening VS Code debugging from the web client (BC23).
key_points: The post is a list of links to page inspection articles, not a standalone tutorial
Topics include analyzing performance and telling standard objects from customized ones
Other links cover controlling or hiding inspection details such as table fields, extensions, filters and the view table action
Version tips: collapsible pane in BC18, text and code field sizes in BC21, field highlighting and VS Code debugging launch in BC23
Related links cover viewing table data, primary key fields and who created records

quotes.text: How to check whether the current page/report is standard or customized
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights a key capability to distinguish between built-in and modified objects
